The Bristle Brigands were a group of niffen bandits. They'd rob travelers on the road then retreat back to their hideout where no one would follow. Their hideout was located in Gaze of Neltharion. At some point in the past, the black dragons that used to inhabit the area moved out, and so Gaze of Neltharion was abandoned. It got a reputation for being haunted by all the experiments the dragons left behind. This made the locals steer clear from the place which caused it to become the Bristle Brigands' hideout.
